name: Autodesk, Inc.
blurb: Autodesk, Inc. provides 3D design, engineering, and entertainment technology solutions worldwide. Its products include AutoCAD, Revit, and Autodesk Build, serving industries such as architecture, engineering, construction, and media. With a market cap of about $51 billion and over 14,000 employees, Autodesk is a leading software company in the design and building information modeling space.
recent: In the past 30 days, ADSK stock has traded in a range of $214.10 to $329.09, closing at $243.08 on May 6, 2026. Notable news includes Michael Burry buying the dip in software stocks amid an AI-fueled sell-off, and analyst commentary on software's AI troubles persisting. The company's next earnings report is scheduled for May 28, 2026.
